title: Creative Option Analysis Demonstration
decision_use: Demonstrate accessible KPI explanations and evidence fields; no operational decision may rely on these synthetic values.

metrics.label: Admissible options
metrics.formula: count(options satisfying every required hard constraint)

metrics.label: Non-dominated options
metrics.formula: count(admissible options not dominated across all declared objectives)
metrics.decision_use: Show trade-off candidates for a later human decision.

metrics.label: Human decision status
metrics.formula: fixed boundary: analysis never selects a binding winner
metrics.decision_use: Prevent automatic activation or design selection.
